text: Increasing the number of virtual nodes N improves NARMA-10 accuracy without limit, so more nodes are always strictly better.
explanation: False. The lab's N sweep (25, 50, 100, 200, 400) shows NMSE improving only up to a saturation point, with diminishing returns thereafter — and more virtual nodes require a smaller θ, trading off against processing speed. Accuracy does not keep improving indefinitely.
